summary: A Tooltip wrapping plain inline text, which becomes the hover and focus trigger.
use: Adding a short explanation to a term or inline phrase without building a custom trigger.
spec: `<Tooltip content="Wrapped in the tooltip's own button">` with plain text children
Children text: hover or focus this text
No trigger snippet, the tooltip renders its own trigger
